name: @go-like/croner
description: Native Croner lifecycle adapter for go-like.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --pretty false && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.json --pretty false && tsc -p tsconfig.e2e.deno.json --pretty false
scripts.test:e2e:runtimes: bun test/e2e/package-runtime.ts && tsx test/e2e/package-runtime.ts && deno test --sloppy-imports --config ../../deno.json test/e2e/deno-runtime.ts
